arguments.command:
@'
import difflib
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/click/testing.py')
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:src/click/testing.py']).splitlines(keepends=True)
current = p.read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True)
a = [line.rstrip(b'\r\n') for line in original]
b = [line.rstrip(b'\r\n') for line in current]
result = []
for tag, i, j, k, l in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, a, b).get_opcodes():
    if tag == 'equal':
        result.extend(original[i:j])
    else:
        result.extend(line + b'\n' for line in b[k:l])
p.write_bytes(b''.join(result))
'@ | python -B -; git --no-pager diff --check; git --no-pager diff --stat; git --no-pager status --short --untracked-files=all
